name: Data Transfer Modifier
description: Modifier transferring some data from a source mesh

props.name: Source Object
props.description: Object to transfer data from

props.name: Object Transform
props.description: Evaluate source and destination meshes in global space

props.name: Vertex Data
props.description: Enable vertex data transfer

props.name: Edge Data
props.description: Enable edge data transfer

props.name: Face Corner Data
props.description: Enable face corner data transfer

props.name: Face Data
props.description: Enable face data transfer

props.name: Vertex Data Types
props.description: Which vertex data layers to transfer

items.name: Vertex Groups
items.description: Transfer active or all vertex groups

items.name: Bevel Weight
items.description: Transfer bevel weights

items.name: Colors
items.description: Transfer color attributes

props.name: Edge Data Types
props.description: Which edge data layers to transfer

items.name: Sharp
items.description: Transfer sharp mark

items.name: UV Seam
items.description: Transfer UV seam mark

items.name: Crease
items.description: Transfer subdivision crease values

items.name: Bevel Weight
items.description: Transfer bevel weights

items.name: Freestyle
items.description: Transfer Freestyle edge mark

props.name: Face Corner Data Types
props.description: Which face corner data layers to transfer

items.name: Custom Normals
items.description: Transfer custom normals

items.name: Colors
items.description: Transfer color attributes

items.name: UVs
items.description: Transfer UV layers

props.name: Poly Data Types
props.description: Which face data layers to transfer

items.name: Smooth
items.description: Transfer flat/smooth mark

items.name: Freestyle Mark
items.description: Transfer Freestyle face mark

props.name: Vertex Mapping
props.description: Method used to map source vertices to destination ones

items.name: Topology
items.description: Copy from identical topology meshes

items.name: Nearest Vertex
items.description: Copy from closest vertex

items.name: Nearest Edge Vertex
items.description: Copy from closest vertex of closest edge

items.name: Nearest Edge Interpolated
items.description: Copy from interpolated values of vertices from closest point on closest edge

items.name: Nearest Face Vertex
items.description: Copy from closest vertex of closest face

items.name: Nearest Face Interpolated
items.description: Copy from interpolated values of vertices from closest point on closest face

items.name: Projected Face Interpolated
items.description: Copy from interpolated values of vertices from point on closest face hit by normal-projection

props.name: Edge Mapping
props.description: Method used to map source edges to destination ones

items.name: Topology
items.description: Copy from identical topology meshes

items.name: Nearest Vertices
items.description: Copy from most similar edge (edge which vertices are the closest of destination edge's ones)

items.name: Nearest Edge
items.description: Copy from closest edge (using midpoints)

items.name: Nearest Face Edge
items.description: Copy from closest edge of closest face (using midpoints)

items.name: Projected Edge Interpolated
items.description: Interpolate all source edges hit by the projection of destination one along its own normal (from vertices)

props.name: Face Corner Mapping
props.description: Method used to map source faces' corners to destination ones

items.name: Topology
items.description: Copy from identical topology meshes

items.name: Nearest Corner and Best Matching Normal
items.description: Copy from nearest corner which has the best matching normal

items.name: Nearest Corner and Best Matching Face Normal
items.description: Copy from nearest corner which has the face with the best matching normal to destination corner's face one

items.name: Nearest Corner of Nearest Face
items.description: Copy from nearest corner of nearest face

items.name: Nearest Face Interpolated
items.description: Copy from interpolated corners of the nearest source face

items.name: Projected Face Interpolated
items.description: Copy from interpolated corners of the source face hit by corner normal projection

props.name: Face Mapping
props.description: Method used to map source faces to destination ones

items.name: Topology
items.description: Copy from identical topology meshes

items.name: Nearest Face
items.description: Copy from nearest face (using center points)

items.name: Best Normal-Matching
items.description: Copy from source face which normal is the closest to destination one

items.name: Projected Face Interpolated
items.description: Interpolate all source polygons intersected by the projection of destination one along its own normal

props.name: Only Neighbor Geometry
props.description: Source elements must be closer than given distance from destination one

props.name: Max Distance
props.description: Maximum allowed distance between source and destination element, for non-topology mappings

props.name: Ray Radius
props.description: 'Width' of rays (especially useful when raycasting against vertices or edges)

props.name: Islands Precision
props.description: Factor controlling precision of islands handling (typically, 0.1 should be enough, higher values can make things really slow)

props.name: Source Layers Selection
props.description: Which layers to transfer, in case of multi-layers types

items.name: Active Layer
items.description: Only transfer active data layer

items.name: All Layers
items.description: Transfer all data layers

items.name: Selected Pose Bones
items.description: Transfer all vertex groups used by selected pose bones

items.name: Deform Pose Bones
items.description: Transfer all vertex groups used by deform bones

props.name: Mix Mode
props.description: How to affect destination elements with source values

items.name: Replace
items.description: Overwrite all elements' data

items.name: Above Threshold
items.description: Only replace destination elements where data is above given threshold (exact behavior depends on data type)

items.name: Below Threshold
items.description: Only replace destination elements where data is below given threshold (exact behavior depends on data type)

items.name: Mix
items.description: Mix source value into destination one, using given threshold as factor

items.name: Add
items.description: Add source value to destination one, using given threshold as factor

items.name: Subtract
items.description: Subtract source value to destination one, using given threshold as factor

items.name: Multiply
items.description: Multiply source value to destination one, using given threshold as factor

props.name: Mix Factor
props.description: Factor to use when applying data to destination (exact behavior depends on mix mode, multiplied with weights from vertex group when defined)

props.name: Vertex Group
props.description: Vertex group name for selecting the affected areas

props.name: Invert
props.description: Invert vertex group influence
